# Architecture decision records

Why this system is the way it is. Each record states the decision, its consequences
(including the negative ones), the alternatives that were rejected **and why**, and what
reversing it would cost.

**Read the relevant record before proposing to change a decision.** Most of the obvious
objections were considered; the record says what happened to them.

New decision? `make adr TITLE="..."`. See [../cookbook/add-adr.md](../cookbook/add-adr.md).
